fonts.text:
Match 3+ consecutive reels starting at the LEFT edge.
Any matching row may connect on each reel. A matching
run away from the left edge does not pay; no reel may be
skipped.

Pay each combination of the longest eligible run once:
bet ÷ 729 × combinations × count paytable factor ×
cabinet factor. WILD substitutes; pure-WILD combinations
pay only as WILD. Shorter subruns do not pay again.

Highlighted cells illustrate positions, not a guaranteed win.
Apply the symbol, direction and region conditions above.
Payouts depend on the paytable and total stake; feature
awards are separate.

diagonal-connected group pays once.

factor × cabinet factor. WILD substitutes for ordinary symbols; an all-WILD
group is paid only as WILD. Follow-up rounds are explained in FEATURES.

prizes.

SCATTER anywhere · 3=20 / 4=39 / 5=78 / 6+=118 coins
Round cap 1,875,000 · All awards rounded
Virtual coins · No cash-out
